subtitles.zh: 我们学到了什么？现在处于什么位置？接下来会怎样，David？
subtitles.en: What do we learn? Where are we? Where does it take us next, David?
Yeah, certainly a lot of whiplash.

subtitles.zh: 我认为重要的一点是，尽管VIX明显因冲击而大幅上升后有所回落，但仍处于较高水平。
subtitles.en: And I think one thing that's important to realize is even though VIX obviously had a sharp wall to the shock and has come in, it's still pretty inflated.

subtitles.zh: 你知道，26、27的水平从历史来看仍显著高于20这一心理关口。
subtitles.en: You know, 26, 27 handle when you look historically is still kind of substantially above that psychological level of 20.

subtitles.zh: 此外，我昨天经常被问到的一个问题是，这是否是一个出清事件？
subtitles.en: Beyond that, you know, I think a question I got yesterday a lot was, is this a clearing event?

subtitles.zh: 我认为市场参与者真的很喜欢问事情是否是出清事件。
subtitles.en: I think investors really like to ask if things are clearing events.

subtitles.zh: 他们也不断问及中期选举。你知道，简短的回答是不幸的是，不是。
subtitles.en: They kept asking that about mid terms as well. You know, the short answer is unfortunately no.

subtitles.zh: 我认为我们正关注12月初，届时英伟达将会有国会证词。
subtitles.en: I think we're looking ahead to early December, where there's going to be congressional testimony from Nvidia.

subtitles.zh: 我认为不幸的是，这一消息流还远未结束。
subtitles.en: I think this news flow is unfortunately far from over.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们只能应对这种波动。
subtitles.en: So we're just going to have to deal with the whiplash instead.

subtitles.zh: 那么VIX现在是否处于合理价位？
subtitles.en: So is this about the right price for the VIX then?

subtitles.zh: 是的，你看，我认为观察VIX时，即使回溯到英伟达黄仁勋所有那些疯狂新闻之前。
subtitles.en: Yeah, you know, look, I think one thing when you look at the VIX is even rewind past all this crazy news of Jensen Huang in Nvidia.

subtitles.zh: 确实有很多担忧，因为相对于我们看到的利率波动，VIX一直反应不大。
subtitles.en: There were really a lot of concerns because the VIX had not been very reactive guide to what we had been seeing in terms of rates volatility.

subtitles.zh: 所以，即使超越中期选举，当你看MOVE与VIX时，有很多关于是否会正常化的问题。
subtitles.en: So, you know, even kind of beyond the mid terms, there was a lot of questions about whether we were going to get normalization when you looked at move versus VIX.

subtitles.zh: 我记得在节目中谈到过，我们在MOVE与VIX方面有些尖锐。
subtitles.en: You know, I remember being on the show and talking about how we were sort of screaming in terms of the move versus VIX.
